subject: ist-pt
title: IST.PT.------INFO.DS.
description: Diagram in WAC-14, one page after the passage where Varèse appears as the first to call for electronic instruments. In WAC-22 Braxton argues that 'no real understanding of transitional western art music can take place unless the composite reality of its extension is taken into account.' (C)IST-PT (isolated particulars) is crossed with INFO-DS (information dissemination): the diagram poses what isolated-particulars (Varèse's electronic instruments, etc.) actually do when they enter the dissemination apparatus of a culture. Besides the main line to INFO-DS, three branches leave the subject. ALT-D (alternative definitions) carries AFN (affinity negation), which branches to APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) and ACC-F (accelerated functionalism). DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) carries CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). AF-COMP (affinity compression) carries MN-DI (mono-dimensional) → IST-F-ACT (isolated focus activism).
